comment: The poly input gets no family: it carries whatever is patched into it. The layout is the SuperCollider Splay arrangement: one channel centred, two hard apart, three at both ends and the centre, and so on, evenly spaced. Panning uses the square-root constant-power law and the sum is scaled down as the channel count rises. The spread knob is configured 0 to 10 and displayed as a percentage at ten per unit; the centre knob -5 to +5 at twenty per unit, which is why one volt at the centre jack is twenty per cent. The panel prints pavo, poly in, spread, center, L and R.
